summary: External GPT-5.5 Pro guardian review of PR #129 (rebased onto main with ADR 0010) returned request_changes (B1: validate_shiki.py should be the fail-closed boundary for committed memory state). On verification the integration already existed (validate_shiki.py traverses .shiki/memories, enforces filename==id, and calls memory_entry_errors), so B1's 'no integration' claim was inaccurate; however two genuine gaps were closed: (1) a memory source.goal_id must now reference an existing goal (referential integrity, mirroring the task goal_id check), and (2) validator-level regression tests prove validate_shiki.py REJECTS directly-committed poisoned memory files (filename!=id, distilled without approval_ledger, dangling goal_id), not just the CLI write path. 127 unit + full shell suite + validators green. Awaiting fresh GPT-5.5 Pro review of the updated head.
